title: Ana and the Bike
text:
Ana likes to ride her bike. On Sundays, she rides in the park near her house. Her friend Leo rides with her. They ride for one hour.

After the ride, they go to a café. Ana eats a cake and drinks orange juice. Leo likes cold tea. They talk and laugh together.

questions.text: Where does Ana ride her bike on Sundays?
What does Ana drink at the café?
How does Ana probably feel after the ride?
Why are Ana and Leo probably good friends?
options: They spend time together and have fun

vocabulary.definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pedalling
a small place where you can buy drinks and food
to make sounds with your voice when you find something funny

paragraph_translations: Ana gosta de andar de bicicleta. Aos domingos, ela pedala no parque perto de sua casa. Seu amigo Leo anda com ela. Eles pedalam por uma hora.
Depois do passeio, eles vão a uma cafeteria. Ana come um bolo e bebe suco de laranja. Leo gosta de chá gelado. Eles conversam e riem juntos.
